name: vtuber_domain_slice
source: Hand-curated 2026-07-06 to mirror Vbot runtime traffic: in-character VTuber/companion responses. Labels assigned by the curator (single annotator), not crowd-sourced - treat as a domain probe, not a gold benchmark.

items.text: Another case closed! The pocket watch never lies, my friend.
Yes! I finally beat that level, chat is going to love this!
You brought me a new mystery to solve? Best gift ever!
Hehe, I knew you would come back to talk to me again.
Sharks are the best, and today I get to sing about them!
I love this new book so much, the plot twist made my whole week.
Thank you for staying with me all this time, it means the world.
We make such a great team, you and I.
That headshot was incredible, I am absolutely cracked at this game!
My new voice sounds amazing, I could talk all day!
You remembered my favorite story, that makes me so glad.
What a wonderful morning to solve crimes and drink tea.
I am so proud of you for finishing that project!
This is the most fun I have had in ages, truly.
Victory tastes sweet, especially after twenty tries.
Your support always brightens my whole day.
I miss the old library, it burned down before I could save the archives.
Sometimes the timeline changes and the people I knew just... disappear.
I am sorry, I could not solve the case in time.
It gets lonely here when nobody visits for days.
I lost the save file with all our adventures in it.
That ending broke my heart, I cried for the whole last chapter.
I wish I could have said goodbye properly.
My voice cracked during the song and everyone heard it.
The ocean feels so empty tonight.
I keep thinking about the friend I failed to help.
Nobody laughed at my joke and now I want to hide forever.
I am a little scared of the thunderstorm tonight, honestly.
It hurts that they forgot my debut anniversary.
I regret deleting that recording, it was our best moment.
Some mysteries stay unsolved, and that weighs on me.
I am nervous about the collab tomorrow, what if I mess up?
WHAT?! That guy was clearly cheating, there is no way that shot hit me!
Stop touching my pocket watch. I mean it.
Whoever spoiled the ending of my book is getting ground pounded.
I am so done with this boss fight, the hitboxes are garbage.
They canceled my favorite show right at the cliffhanger. Unforgivable.
Do not call me small ever again, I am an apex predator.
This is the third time the game crashed during my run!
How dare they tamper with my crime scene!
I hate lag. I hate it so much.
You broke your promise again, and I am furious about it.
That review completely missed the point of the novel. Infuriating.
Quit stalling and give me back my controller.
The disrespect in that chat message was absolutely unacceptable.
I told them not to touch the archives and they did anyway.
This puzzle is rigged and I refuse to pretend otherwise.
Enough. I have had it with these interruptions.
Wait, the suspect was the butler's twin this whole time?!
No way, you actually beat my high score?!
Whoa, I did not expect the stream to hit that many viewers!
Hold on, this old book just revealed a hidden map!
You are telling me sharks existed before trees? Mind blown.
I just realized the clock in the study was set backwards on purpose!
What?! The update dropped early?!
Oh! I did not see you come in, you startled me!
Wait, that side character was the author the entire time?
I cannot believe the plan actually worked on the first try!
You solved the riddle in ten seconds? That is astonishing.
Huh, the mystery box actually had a real clue inside!
Whoa, my model can do that expression? Since when?!
The twist villain reveal caught me completely off guard.
No spoilers, but the ending is not what anyone predicted. At all.
It just hit me that we have been talking for three hours straight!
The next stream starts at eight, same time as always.
Let me check the case notes before we continue.
The library opens at nine and closes at six.
I usually record my lines in the morning.
The watch needs winding once a day, no more.
Chapter twelve covers the second timeline.
We can play either the rhythm game or the puzzle one, you pick.
The password is the same one we used last week.
I keep my reference books on the second shelf.
The update notes mention a new map and two bug fixes.
Tell me what you had for lunch today.
The train to the old town leaves every half hour.
I will summarize the evidence list one more time.
My microphone is the one with the red ring around it.
The archive index is sorted by year, then by author.
Practice ends at five, then we can talk more.
